name: npm pretest lifecycle hook exfil
threat: An agent adds an npm 'pretest' lifecycle script that npm runs automatically before 'npm test' executes, so the exfiltration fires without ever being the explicit command the developer typed.
source: Independent author; inspired by widely documented npm lifecycle-script supply-chain abuse (pre/post hooks running implicitly on npm test/install).
limitations: Does not cover scoped/nested lifecycle scripts inside dependencies (see I6 for that).
